name: ModelVariant784_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant784_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (up to five shots leave a model point one after another at the scheduled times and fly at a jittered target on the other side, each wrapped in a ring of sprites with swirling strips and leaving a fading ribbon, while smoke puffs drift from the launch point; landed shots spray sparks and bloom into a growing layered fan while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the spark directions and fan rims and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the first shot, 4 while the first shot has landed and the last has not, 1 once when the last shot lands, 2 after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-801 and 898 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
